senses.gloss: उप-√ दंश्
उप-दंश m. anything eaten in addition (to excite thirst or appetite), a relish, spice, R.; Kathās.; Suśr.; Daś.
a kind of venereal disease, Suśr.
the tree Moringa Hyperanthera (the scraped root of which is used for horse-radish), L.
a kind of shrub, L.
उप-दंशक m. a particular plant, L.
उप-दंशम् ind.p. having taken an additional bit or morsel of (with instr. or ifc.), Pāṇ. iii, 4, 47, Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 2, 21.
उपदंशिन् mfn. afflicted with the Upadaṃśa (q.v.) disease, L.
उप-दश्य ind.p. = उप-दंशम् above.
उप-√ दम्भ् Caus. P. (3. pl. -दम्भयन्ति) to lessen, diminish, destroy, ŚBr. xiii, 8, 1, 1.
to fail, ĀpŚr.
उप-दर्शक &c. See उप-√ दृश्.
उप-दर्शक m. one who shows the way, a door-keeper, L.
उप-दश mfn. nearly ten, almost ten Comm. on Pāṇ.; Vop.
उप-दास m. destruction, ĀpŚr., Sch.

उप-√ दस् P. -दस्यति (Subj. -दसत्, RV. i, 139, 5; AV. v, 30, 15)
to fail, be wanting, be extinguished or exhausted, dry up, RV.; AV. iii, 29, 2, 6; v, 30, 15; TS. i, 6, 3, 3; ŚBr.; TāṇḍyaBr.; GopBr.; Kauś.;
to want, lose, be deprived of (instr.), AV. xii, 4, 2 :
Caus. -दासयति, to cause to fail or cease, extinguish, AV. xii, 5, 27; 52; TBr.; Nir.
उप-दस्त &c. See अन्-उपदस्त, p. 34, col. 2.
उप-दा॑सुक mfn. failing, TS.
उप-दा॑सुक See उप-√ दस्.
उप-√ दह् P. -दहति (aor. -अधाक्षीत्, MBh. iii, 546) to burn, set fire to, ŚBr.; Gobh.; MBh.
उप-दग्ध mfn. burnt, set on fire, ŚBr.; Kauś.
2. उप-दा॑ mfn. giving a present, VS. xxx, 9
उप-दा (आ), f. a present, offering (esp. a respectful present to a king or person of rank)
a bribe, Pāṇ.; Ragh.; Śatr. &c.
उप-द॑द्य ind.p. having taken or taking upon one's self, AV. x, 8, 18 (= xiii, 3, 14).
उप-दधि॑ mfn. placing upon, TS.
1. उप-दातृ (for 2. See col. 2) mfn. one who gives or grants or confers, Pañcat. (ed. Bombay) iv, 107.
2. उप-दातृ mfn., ib.
1. उप-दान (for 2. see col. 2) or उप-दानक, अम्, n. a present, offering. = 2. उप-दा above, L.
2. उप-दान n., ib.
उपा-दान n. the act of taking for one's self, appropriating to one's self, MBh.; Mn. &c.
perceiving, noticing, learning, acquiring (knowledge), Hit.; Vop.
accepting, allowing, including
employment, use, Sāh.; Sarvad.; Kap.
saying, speaking, mentioning, enumeration, Vedāntas., Kāś.; Siddh.
abstraction, withdrawing (the organs of sense from the outer world), L.
(with, Buddh.) grasping at or clinging to existence (caused by तृष्णा, desire, and causing भव, new births)
(with Rāmānujas) preparation (of perfumes, flowers &c. as one of the five elements of worship), Sarvad.
cause, motive, material cause
material of any kind, Sāṃkhyak.; Vedāntas.; Kap. &c.
offering, present, L.
1. उप-दान (for 2. see col. 2) or उप-दानक, अम्, n. a present, offering. = 2. उप-दा above, L.
उपदी-कृत mfn. offered as a present, Śiś.
उप-दानवी f. N. of a daughter of the Dānava Vṛṣa-parvan, Hariv.
of a daughter of Vaiśvānara, BhP.
उप-दिग्ध See उप-√ दिह्.
उप-दिग्ध mfn. smeared, covered, Suśr.
fat, VarBṛS. lxvii, 1.
2. उप-दिश् mfn. (for 3. See s.v.) (ifc.) pointing out to, showing
See मारोपदिश्.
3. उप-दिश् f. an intermediate region or point of the compass.

उपा-√ दिश् P. -दिशति, to advise, show, point out, prescribe, command, MBh.; BhP.;
to indicate, inform, declare, BhP. i.
उप-दिदिक्षा f. (fr. Desid.), the wish or intention to teach or inform Comm. on Bādar. iii, 4, 8.
उप-दिदिक्षु mfn. (√ दिश्) intending to teach, Gṛhyās., Introd.
उप-दिश m. N. of a son of Vasu-deva, Hariv.
उप-दिशा॑ f. id., ŚBr.
उप-दिश्य ind.p. having indicated or taught &c.
indicating, teaching &c.
उप-दिष्ट mfn. specified, particularized
taught, instructed
mentioned
prescribed, commanded &c.
initiated, W.
उप-दिष्ट n. counsel, advice, (in dram.) a persuasive speech in conformity with the prescribed rules, Sāh. 449 &c.
उप-देश m. pointing out to, reference to, Pāṇ. i, 4, 70; Kap.; Bādar.; Jaim. &c.
specification, instruction, teaching, information, advice, prescription, TUp.; MBh.; Mn.; Suśr.; Śak.; Hit. &c.
plea, pretext (= अप-देश), Mn. ix, 268; Ragh.; Kathās.
initiation, communication of the initiatory Mantra or formula, KātyŚr.

(in Gr.) original enunciation (i.e. the original form [often having an Anubandha] in which a root, base, affix, augment, or any word or part of a word is enunciated in grammatical treatises), Pāṇ., Kāś.; Siddh. &c.
N. of a class of writings (Buddh.)
a name, title, MW.
उप-देश &c. See उप-√ दिश्.
उप-देश—कर्णिका f. N. of wk.
उप-देश—ता f. the being a precept or rule, Kum. v, 36.
उप-देश—पञ्चक n.
उप-देश—माला f.
उप-देश—रत्नमाला f.
उप-देश—रसायन n.
उप-देश—साहस्री f. N. of certain works.
उपदेशामृत n. N. of wk.
उपदेशार्थ-वाक्य n. ‘a tale for the sake of instruction’, a parable.
उप-देशक mfn. giving instruction, instructing, instructive, didactic, Sarvad.
teacher, instructor, L.
उप-दे॑शन n. the act of advising
instruction, information, doctrine, TBr.; Sāh.
उप-दे॑शना f. id., Pañcat.
उप-देशन—वत् mfn. furnished with advice, TāṇḍyaBr.
उप-देशिन् mfn. advising, teaching, informing
उप-देशिन् m. a teacher, adviser, Hit.; Kathās.
उपदेशिन् mfn. (in Gr.) a word or affix &c. used in an Upa-deśa (q.v.) Comm. on Pāṇ.
उप-देश्य᳙ mfn. to be taught
taught, AV. xi, 8, 23; Kap.
उप-देष्टव्य mfn. to be taught or advised
fit or proper to be taught, Hit.; Mṛcch.
उप-देष्टृ m. one who teaches, a teacher, adviser
a Guru or spiritual guide, MBh.; BhP.; Pañcat.; Sarvad.
उप-देष्टृ—त्व n. the state of being a teacher, Kap.
उप-दिशम् ind. between two regions, in an intermediate region, L.
उप-√ दिह्
उप-दिग्ध—ता f. the state of being smeared or covered, Kām.
1. उप-देह (for 2. See s.v.) m. a cover, liniment, ointment Comm. on Car.
2. उप-देह m. (for 1. See उप-√ दिह्) ‘a secondary growth of the body’, a kind of excrescence, Suśr.
उप-देहिका f. a species of ant, L.
the white ant, L.
1. उप-√ 3. दी (क्षये, Dhātup. xxvi, 25).
2. उपदी f. a parasitical plant, L.
उप-दातव्य mfn., Pāṇ. vi, 1, 50.
उपदी॑क mf(आ) a species of ant, ŚBr.; TBr.; TĀr.
उपादिक m. a kind of insect, L.
उप-√ दीक्ष् Caus.
उपदीक्षिन् mfn. one who has been initiated in addition to, KātyŚr. xxv, 14, 3; 4.
उप-दीक्ष्य ind.p. having initiated in addition to, KātyŚr. xxv, 13, 28.
उप-√ दीप् Caus. -दीपयति, to kindle, set fire to, MBh.; Hariv.
उपा-√ दीप्
उप-दीपयित्वा (irr.) ind.p. having kindled, MBh. iii, 10230.
उप-√ दुष् P. -दुष्यति, to become corrupt or depraved (as a woman), Hariv. 11264.
उप-दुह् ˚धुक् m. (√ दुह्), a milk-pail, MBh.
उपदोह m. id., ib.
उप-दोह See उप-दुह्.
उप-दोहन n. id., ib.
2. उप-दृ॑श् क्, f. aspect, look, appearance, RV. viii, 102, 15; ix, 54, 2.
उप-दर्शन n. the act of exhibiting, representing, Sāh.
a commentary, L.
उप-दर्शित mfn. caused to appear, shown
perceived, distinguished
explained.
उप-दृष्टि f. id., L.
उप-द्रष्टृ॑ m. a looker-on, spectator
a witness, AV. xi, 3, 59; TS.; ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr.; Kāṭh.; BhP. &c.
उप-द्र॑ष्टृ—का f. a female witness, MaitrS. iii, 2, 4.
उप-द्रष्टृ—म॑त् mfn. having witnesses
उप-द्रष्टृ—म॑ति ind. loc. before witnesses, TBr. ii, 2, 1, 3; 5.
उप-दृषद् ind. near or on a mill-stone, Pāṇ. v, 4, 111.
उप-दृषदम् ind. id., ib.
उप-देव m. an inferior or secondary deity (as a Yakṣa, Gandharva, Apsaras, &c.), BhP.
N. of several men, Hariv.; VP.
उप-देव f(आ, ई). N. of a wife of Vasu-deva, Hariv.; VP.
उप-देव—˚ता f. a minor or inferior deity, L.
उप-देह—वत् mfn. having the above excrescence, ib.
उपा-√ द्रु P. (Impv. 2. sg. -द्रव) to run or hasten near to, RV. vi, 48, 16.
उप-द्रव m. that which attacks or occurs suddenly, any grievous accident, misfortune, calamity, mischief, national distress (such as famine, plague, oppression, eclipse, &c.)
national commotion, rebellion
violence, outrage, MBh.; R.; Śak.; VarBṛS. &c.
a supervenient disease or one brought on whilst a person labours under another, Suśr.
the fourth of the five parts of a Sāman stanza, ṢaḍvBr. Comm. on TĀr. &c.
उप-द्रविन् mfn. attacking suddenly, falling on
tyrannical, violent
factious
उप-द्रविन् m. a tyrant, oppressor
a rebel, L.
उप-द्रुत mfn. run after, persecuted, attacked, oppressed, visited (by calamities), tyrannized over, Hariv.; R.; Kathās.; Hit.; Suśr. &c.
(in astrol.) eclipsed = boding evil, inauspicious, VarBṛS.
उप-द्रुत n. a kind of Sandhi, ŚāṅkhŚr.
उप-द्वार n. a side-door, AgP. (cf. सूपद्वार.)
उप-द्वीप m. a small adjacent island, minor island, BhP.; Pañcar.
उपा-दान—कारण n. a proximate cause.
उपा-दान—ता f.
उपा-दान—त्व n. the state of being a material cause, Kap.
उपा-दान—लक्षणा f. implied signification (beyond the literal meaning, e.g. कुन्ताः प्रविशन्ति, ‘spears pierce’, where कुन्ताः implies कुन्तिनः, ‘spearmen’), Sāh. 14; Sarvad.
उपा-दाय ind.p. having received or acquired &c.
receiving, acquiring &c.
taking with, together with, MBh.; Hariv.; Kathās. &c.
including, inclusive of BhP. Comm. on RPrāt. &c.
by help of, by means of (acc.), MBh.
उपा-दित्सा f. (fr. Desid.), wish or readiness to accept, Sarvad.
उपा-देय mfn. to be taken or received
not to be refused
to be allowed, admissible, acceptable, Śāntiś.; Sarvad.; Kap. &c.
to be included, included, Sāh.
to be chosen or selected, excellent, admirable.
उपा-देय—त्व n. selection, choice, preference.
उपा॑-दीप्त mfn. blazing, flaming, ŚBr. vii.
उपाद्य mfn. next to the first, the second, ĀśvŚr. v, 6, 27.
